articles.summary: An invoice is a document, usually sent by a supplier to a customer, providing details about the goods or services the seller has provided and the amount the buyer owes.
articles.title: What is an invoice?

articles.summary: Malaysia has announced a two month delay for the adoption of B2B e-invoicing. Taxpayers with annual turnover of MYR 100 or above must comply with e-invoicing from Aug 1st, 2024
articles.title: Malaysia delays B2B e-invoicing to August 2024

articles.summary: Ireland's tax collection agency has launched a public consultation to modernize the country's VAT invoicing and reporting system.
articles.title: Ireland publishes a public consultation on e-invoicing
